Application Data.NAME: ABC Tire & Automotive Center
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ABC Tire & Automotive Center specializes in providing comprehensive tire and automotive services, including tire installation, rotation, balancing, and repair. Our operations focus on ensuring quality service and customer satisfaction while adhering to industry safety standards. We maintain a well-organized inventory of tires and automotive parts, ensuring compliance with maximum inventory limits to mitigate fire hazards. Our facility is equipped with modern equipment, including automated tire inflation systems that feature pressure monitoring and safety shutoff mechanisms, aligning with best practices to enhance safety during tire service operations.

Underwriting Guidelines:
• No Towing or Contract Wrecking Services: These activities introduce elevated liability
and physical damage exposures that are outside the scope of standard BOP underwriting for
tire and automotive centers.
• Inventory Restrictions: Maximum inventory limits apply to tires and automotive parts
to reduce fire hazard and storage risk. Excessive stockpiling without proper fire suppression
systems will lead to declination.
Unique Industry-Related Restriction: Use of Automated Tire Inflation Systems Must
Include Pressure Monitoring and Safety Shutoff Features. Automated tire inflation systems
that lack real-time pressure monitoring and automatic shutoff mechanisms pose a risk of over-
inflation, potentially causing tire blowouts during installation or customer use. Underwriters should
verify that such systems comply with industry safety standards (e.g., SAE J267) to mitigate this
hazard.
